lead.headline: Jefferson and Addison come down to a pregame workout; two checks at 09:30
lead.deck: Written before the inactive lists. Kamara is expected to play, McLaurin leans that way, Dowdle is unlikely to, and nobody will say about the two Vikings.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players. Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison are both still questionable, and the only Sunday-morning word is Ian Rapoport's: both will work out before the game and Minnesota will decide from how they look. No insider has said either is expected to play, and each is the other's cover. Kyle Monangai is out with turf toe and nothing new on how long. You are 0–4 and trail 31.5 to nothing; ESPN gives you 47%. The rest of the morning went your way. Alvin Kamara is expected to play, by Rapoport. Terry McLaurin is a game-time decision with a slight lean toward playing, by ESPN's beat writer on Saturday. Adam Schefter says Rico Dowdle is unlikely to play, and ESPN had already acted on it: Jaylen Warren's projection rose from 14.5 to 17.7 overnight. Bhayshul Tuten was not on London's inactive list and kicked off at 07:30. The rain at Landover now looks light, not heavy. This edition is written two hours before the inactive lists, so everything conditional in it is provisional. At 09:30 read four names, Jefferson, Addison, McLaurin and Kamara, and fire the two cards below from the list.
